meta.subject: ramulator memory addressing bug fix + platform memory refactoring

en.summary: Fixes multi-bank platform-memory addressing so RTL adapters and simulators agree on bank-interleaved byte-address formation, including the ramulator-backed model.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly says memory addressing bug fix.
The patch changes the RTL AXI adapter and matching simulator address formulas.
The corrected behavior is bank mapping and byte-address formation, which is real DUT and model correctness.
disqualifiers: The commit is broad and also includes substantial platform-memory refactoring and build-file churn.
evidence: Vortex_axi.sv flips the AXI adapter from INTERLEAVE=0 to INTERLEAVE=PLATFORM_MEMORY_INTERLEAVE.
VX_axi_adapter.sv adds an interleaved address formula that inserts bank bits into the outgoing byte address.
rtlsim, simx, and dram_sim all change their byte-address reconstruction to the new mapping.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a banked memory system, every adapter and model must agree on where bank-select bits live inside the physical byte address. If one side assumes contiguous regions per bank while another side assumes low-order bank interleaving, requests land on the wrong bank or wrong byte address.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The platform exposes multiple memory banks or channels and the interconnect must translate a logical block address into a bank-qualified physical byte address.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Disable bank interleaving or strip the bank-select bits back out of the physical-address formula so the design falls back to the old contiguous-per-bank mapping.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: strip bank-select insertion from address generation
portability_notes: Apply this to any memory adapter or simulator that rebuilds physical byte addresses from bank id plus block address.
The reusable bug is disagreement over bank-bit placement in the global address map.
concrete_injection_steps: Find where the adapter turns an internal block address plus bank id into a physical byte address.
Remove the inserted bank bits or force non-interleaved mapping.
If a simulator reconstructs addresses from bank and block fields, revert it to the same old assumption.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: platform-memory bank interleaving in the AXI adapter and matching simulator address reconstruction
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix enables platform-memory interleaving in the RTL adapter and updates simulator and DRAM-model address formulas to insert and reconstruct bank bits consistently.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Set the adapter back to non-interleaved mode and revert the bank-bit insertion and byte-address reconstruction formulas to the old contiguous-per-bank mapping.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Adjacent addresses can land on the wrong bank or wrong byte address, causing bank aliasing, corrupted data, or RTL/model mismatches.
evidence_for_injection: The top-level RTL explicitly changes the adapter INTERLEAVE parameter.
The adapter adds a new interleaved address formula rather than only renaming macros.
Both rtlsim and simx change address reconstruction, confirming a real mapping mismatch.
notes: Despite the surrounding refactor, the central semantic change is corrected bank-address mapping.
If only one injection is desired, mutate the RTL adapter first.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了多 bank 平台内存的寻址问题，使 RTL adapter 和 simulator 在按 bank 交织的字节地址形成上保持一致，其中也包括基于 ramulator 的模型。
why_it_counts: 提交标题明确写明是 memory addressing bug fix。
补丁修改了 RTL AXI adapter 以及匹配的 simulator 地址公式。
被修正的是 bank 映射和字节地址形成，这属于真实的 DUT 与模型正确性问题。
disqualifiers: 该提交范围较大，同时包含较多平台内存重构和构建文件调整。
evidence: Vortex_axi.sv 把 AXI adapter 从 INTERLEAVE=0 改成了 INTERLEAVE=PLATFORM_MEMORY_INTERLEAVE。
VX_axi_adapter.sv 新增了交织地址公式，会把 bank 位插入到输出字节地址中。
rtlsim、simx 和 dram_sim 都同步改写了字节地址重建逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 banked memory system 中，所有 adapter 和模型都必须一致地定义 bank-select 位在物理字节地址中的位置。如果一侧按每个 bank 连续分段理解地址，而另一侧按低位 bank 交织理解地址，请求就会落到错误的 bank 或错误的字节地址。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 按 bank 交织的物理地址形成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 平台暴露了多个 memory bank 或 channel，而互连需要把逻辑 block 地址转换成带 bank 身份的物理字节地址。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 关闭 bank interleaving，或者把 bank-select 位从物理地址公式中去掉，使系统退回旧的按 bank 连续分段映射。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: strip bank-select insertion from address generation
portability_notes: 适用于任何根据 bank id 和 block 地址重建物理字节地址的 memory adapter 或 simulator。
可复用缺陷的本质是全局地址图中 bank 位位置理解不一致。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 adapter 把内部 block 地址加上 bank id 转换成物理字节地址的位置。
删除插入的 bank 位，或者强制恢复非交织映射。
如果 simulator 也会重建地址，则把它的公式一起改回旧假设。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AXI adapter 中的平台内存 bank 交织及 simulator 对应的地址重建逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 RTL adapter 中启用了平台内存交织，并同步修改 simulator 与 DRAM 模型的地址公式，使 bank 位的插入和重建保持一致。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 adapter 改回非交织模式，并把 bank 位插入与字节地址重建公式恢复到旧的按 bank 连续分段映射。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 相邻地址请求可能落到错误的 bank 或错误字节地址，造成 bank 别名、数据损坏，或 RTL 与模型行为不一致。
evidence_for_injection: RTL 顶层显式修改了 adapter 的 INTERLEAVE 参数。
adapter 中新增的是新的交织地址公式，而不是单纯宏重命名。
rtlsim 和 simx 都同步改写了地址重建逻辑，说明这是实质性的映射失配。
notes: 虽然周围伴随较多重构，但核心语义变化就是 bank 地址映射被修正。
如果只选一个注入点，优先修改 RTL adapter。
